issues.description: The solution for Aufgabe 05 uses COUNT(flaeche) while the problem statement requests the average area (durchschnittliche Fläche) per Kreis. This contradicts the exercise requirement and will mislead students using the solution as a reference (COUNT returns a count of non-null values instead of the average numeric value requested).
issues.suggestedFix: In solution/aufgabe05.sql replace COUNT(flaeche) with AVG(flaeche) so the query returns the average area as requested. The corrected query should SELECT regierungsbezirk, kreis, AVG(flaeche) FROM Gemeinde GROUP BY regierungsbezirk, kreis ORDER BY kreis.
